module_title: Advanced Macro-Policy Matrix - Debt Dynamics, FDI Safe Harbours, and Strategic Semiconductors
introduction: This advanced tier is curated for UPSC Mains, RBI Grade B Phase 2, and Economics Optionals. It dissects the government's long-term sovereign debt strategies, highly technical tax holidays for FDI, and the aggressive localization of strategic supply chains.

core_concepts.title: Sovereign Debt Consolidation Path
core_concepts.description: While the Debt-to-GDP ratio for FY 2026-27 is estimated at **55.6%** (down from 56.1% in FY26 RE), the Finance Minister laid out a rigorous long-term roadmap. The central government explicitly aims to reduce its outstanding liabilities to around **50% of GDP by March 2031**.

core_concepts.title: Frontier Manufacturing: Semiconductors & Rare Earths
core_concepts.description:
- **India Semiconductor Mission (ISM) 2.0:** Officially launched to shift focus from just packaging to producing equipment/materials and designing full-stack Indian IP.
- **Dedicated Rare Earth Corridors:** Established exclusively in four mineral-rich coastal states—**Odisha, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu**—to promote the mining and processing of critical minerals vital for the energy transition.

core_concepts.title: Services Export & FDI Incentives
core_concepts.description:
- **Tax Holiday for Cloud Services:** A massive incentive granting a tax holiday until **2047** to foreign cloud service providers utilizing Indian infrastructure.
- **Safe Harbour for IT Services:** A single unified category for 'Information Technology Services' (clubbing software, KPO, and ITES) has been created with a common safe harbour margin of **15.5%**. Crucially, the threshold to avail this has been hiked from ₹300 Crore to **₹2,000 Crore**.

core_concepts.title: Foreign Portfolio Investment (FPI/PROI)
core_concepts.description: To deepen the equity markets, the investment limit for individual Persons Resident Outside India (PROI) under the Portfolio Investment Scheme has been doubled from 5% to **10%** in listed Indian companies.

important_entities.name: Customs Framework Overhaul
important_entities.significance: A major Ease of Doing Business reform. The customs warehousing framework is being transformed into a warehouse operator-centric system relying heavily on self-declarations and risk-based audits, eliminating massive bureaucratic bottlenecks for supply chains.

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: When discussing the new Dedicated Rare Earth Corridors, UPSC will intentionally include states like Karnataka, Jharkhand, or Gujarat in the options. You must strictly limit your selection to the explicitly announced 4 states: **Odisha, Kerala, Andhra Pradesh, and Tamil Nadu**.

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: An acronym to memorize the 4 Rare Earth states: **O**disha, **K**erala, **A**ndhra Pradesh, and **T**amil Nadu.

exam_strategy_tips: In UPSC GS Paper 3 (Economy), use the 'Debt-to-GDP target of 50% by 2031' as a concluding argument when writing essays on India's macroeconomic stability or fiscal prudence. It demonstrates a deep understanding of the government's long-term horizons beyond the immediate fiscal year.
